ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   B. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   C. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   C. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
